chunks: # Eligibility Criteria for University Admissions 2026 ## B.Tech Computer Science To be eligible for the B.Tech Computer Science program, applicants must meet the following criteria: - Minimum of 75% aggregate in 10+2 (High School) Board Examinations. - Must have studied Physics, Mathematics, and Chemistry as core subjects. - Must have a valid rank in the Joint Entrance Examination (JEE) Mains 2026. - The application deadline is May 15th, 2026. ## MBA (Master of Business Administration) To be eligible for the MBA program, applicants must meet the following criteria: - A completed Bachelor's degree in any discipline with a minimum

of 60% aggregate. - A valid CAT/MAT/XAT score from the 2025/2026 session. - Minimum 2 years of full-time work experience (preferred but not mandatory). - The application deadline is June 30th, 2026. ## Reservation Policy As per institutional guidelines, 15% of seats are reserved for SC candidates, 7.5% for ST candidates, and 27% for OBC candidates. A 5% relaxation in minimum aggregate marks is provided to candidates under these categories.

# University Fee Structure 2026-2027 ## B.Tech Programs - **Tuition Fee:** $5,000 per semester - **Development Fee:** $500 per semester - **Library & Lab Fee:** $200 per semester - **Hostel Fee (Optional):** $1,200 per semester (includes mess charges) - **Caution Deposit (Refundable):** $300 (one-time payment at admission) Total required at the time of admission (without hostel): $6,000. ## MBA Program - **Tuition Fee:** $8,000 per semester - **Development Fee:** $1,000 per semester - **Library & Lab Fee:** $300 per semester - **Hostel Fee (Optional):** $1,200 per semester (includes mess charges) - **Caution Deposit (Refundable):** $500 (one-time payment at admission) Total

required at the time of admission (without hostel): $9,800. ## Scholarships - **Merit Scholarship:** Students in the top 5% of the entrance exam rank list receive a 50% waiver on tuition fees for the first year. - **Need-based Financial Aid:** Available for students with an annual family income less than $10,000. Requires submission of valid income certificates.
